sloka: आबध्य च शुभे तूणी चापे च आदाय सस्वने ।निष्क्रान्तौ आश्रमात् गन्तुम् उभौ तौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥३-८-१९॥
transliteration: ābadhya ca śubhe tūṇī cāpe ca ādāya sasvane ।niṣkrāntau āśramāt gantum ubhau tau rāma lakṣmaṇau ॥3-8-19॥

translations.english: Both Rama and Lakshmana tied their auspicious quivers, took the two twanging bows and departed from the hermitage.
